newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices fall on low mill demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices fall on low mill demand.

text.p: Indian cotton prices fell on Thursday on low mill demand and rising new crop arrivals, traders said.
Daily new crop arrivals in the Punjab region rose to 9-10,000 bales (170 kg each) against 4-5,000 bales last week.
In spot deals Bengal-deshi ready delivery fell by 10/20 rupees to 840/880 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while November delivery was available at 830/835 rupees per maund.
Gujarat Kalyan (medium-staple) fell by 100 rupees to 12,400/12,500 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).
